articles.title: Houses Are Falling Into the Ocean — And One Rule Makes It Hard to Stop
articles.summary: In North Carolina, more than 30 beachfront homes have fallen into the ocean since 2020. One house called Sea 'n Delight is stuck on stilts in the sand. A rule says owners only get flood insurance money after a house collapses, not before.

articles.title: Chelsea Soccer Club Has a New Boss — And a Big Goal
articles.summary: Chelsea, a famous English soccer club, just changed owners. Clearlake Capital now controls the team, and Todd Boehly is out. Coach Xabi Alonso says the goal is simple: win big trophies.

articles.title: Senate Moves Closer to Changing College Sports Forever
articles.summary: The U.S. Senate voted 74-24 to move forward on a bill that would change how college athletes get paid, transfer, and go to court. It could become law soon.
